newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stockholm bourse says to look into P&U call claim.
newsitem.headline: Stockholm bourse says to look into P&U call claim.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse said on Friday it would investigate information that U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn had talked down analysts' profit forecasts before releasing half year results.
Reuters earlier on Friday reported a number of analysts saying they had been contacted by the company recently and told the market forecasts for P&U for the second quarter were too high.
"If the information in the Reuters article is true then it is clearly unacceptable," Hans Edenhammar, head of the bourse's information services, told Reuters.
"We will investigate this information first hand through contact with the company."
P&U shares were trading four crowns higher at 262.5 at 1400 GMT on Friday.
